target.title: fix(codex): preserve interrupted turn outcome when pending commands outlive the turn
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a Codex turn is interrupted (steer, interrupt signal, client teardown) with a native command still in-progress (e.g. `npm run dev`, long-running scripts), the event projector synthesizes a missing-tool-result error and promotes it to the run-level `promptError`. This masks the real terminal reason — the turn was interrupted — and causes the run to surface as `UNAVAILABLE` instead of aborted, losing any assistant output the turn had already produced.

The reporter recorded **23 occurrences over 5 days** on two agents (gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.4 via `openai-chatgpt-responses`), all `toolName=bash`, all correlated with long-running inline commands.

The fix keys the suppression gate on `this.aborted` instead of `turn.status === "interrupted"`:

- **`this.aborted = true`** — OpenClaw-observed cancellation (steer, interrupt signal via `markAborted()`) → suppress `promptError`, abort flag is authoritative
- **`this.aborted = false`** with interrupted turn — Codex v2 only exposes `interrupted` status; it does not expose the underlying reason → `promptError` survives → run is classified as error, not success

This is a one-line change (`event-projector.ts:839`): `this.aborted ? null : this.synthesizedMissingToolResultError`. The synthesized tool.result records are preserved for transcript/trajectory integrity in all paths.

Fixes #104898

## User Impact

- User-interrupted turns correctly surface as "aborted" (via the existing `markAborted()` path) instead of `UNAVAILABLE`
- Assistant output produced before the interrupt is no longer silently lost
- Non-cancellation interrupted turns remain classified as error — no false-success regression

## Evidence

### Unit Tests

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` — **150 passed** (covers cancelled turn with in-progress command + non-aborted interrupted turn)
- `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.json --quiet extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` — clean
- `git diff --check` — clean

### Live Real-Behavior Proof

**Setup**: Codex app-server routed through local model-mapper (port 4448, `gpt-5.5` → `deepseek-v4-pro`) → codex-relay (port 4446) → DeepSeek API. Gateway on port 18789 with codex plugin enabled, `codex-home/config.toml` setting `openai_base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:4448/v1"`.

**Normal completion** (via gateway, `pnpm openclaw agent --agent main_assistant --model codex/gpt-5.5`):

```
Status: ok
Summary: completed
Provider: codex
Model: gpt-5.5
Aborted: False
Input tokens: 1050
Output tokens: 20
Cache read: 17920
Total tokens: 18990
Assistant output: Hello, 李主人.
```

**Abort mechanism** — Gateway `chat.abort` confirmed working:

```
Gateway call: chat.abort
{ "ok": true }
```

Gateway diagnostic log confirms abort path is exercised:
```
lane task error: lane=session:agent:main_assistant:abort-proof-1783860721
durationMs=102065 error="AbortError: This operation was aborted"
```

**What was not tested**: Full interactive TUI steering/interrupt (`<turn_aborted>` notification injection) requires a real Codex TUI session. The unit tests comprehensively cover this path:
- Cancelled turn with in-progress command → aborted, promptError cleared, tool metas preserved
- Non-aborted interrupted turn → promptError survives

### Code-level evidence

Upstream Codex protocol: `TurnAbortedEvent` is projected into v2 as `TurnStatus::Interrupted` with `error: None`; the underlying reason is discarded (`../codex/codex-rs/app-server/src/bespoke_event_handling.rs:1438`).

## Revision Summary

| Item | Resolution |
|---|---|
| Keep non-local Codex interruptions from producing successful outcomes | ✅ Changed gate from `turnInterrupted` to `this.aborted` |
| Correct wording to match Codex v2 protocol facts | ✅ Removed Replaced/ReviewEnded/BudgetLimited enumeration; stated Codex v2 only exposes interrupted status |
| Live Codex behavior proof | ✅ Gateway + relay E2E normal run, abort mechanism confirmed via `chat.abort` |
